paraphrase: With body, speech and mind I bow to all the buddhas of the three times in all worlds; I make offerings; I confess all wrongs done through desire, anger and delusion; I rejoice in the merit of all beings and buddhas; I request the buddhas to turn the wheel; I request those about to pass into nirvāṇa to remain for aeons; I dedicate all merit to awakening.
notes: Reference from the unit author's knowledge at chapter level; passage not read in a local text in this phase. Verse numbers approximate; the sevenfold structure is certain.

paraphrase: At the close of Samantabhadra's vows the practitioner aspires: at the moment of death, may all obstacles be removed, may I see Amitābha face to face and be born at once in Sukhāvatī, and there fulfil these vows and benefit all beings.
speaker: Samantabhadra
notes: Not read locally; verse numbers approximate (low).

paraphrase: Samantabhadra's ten great vows (40-fascicle Avataṃsaka, T293 fasc. 40): to pay homage to all buddhas; praise the Tathāgatas; make vast offerings; repent karmic obstructions; rejoice in merit; request the turning of the wheel; request the buddhas to remain; always follow the buddhas' teaching; always accord with beings; dedicate all merit — until space, beings, karma and afflictions end; at death they lead one to Sukhāvatī.
